finalText: Migration complete. All 11 remaining `db.query` call sites under `packages/` (in `macroAdmin.js`, `sla.js`, `returnService.js`, `cohort.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `couponService.js`, `refund.js`, `supplier.js`, `shipment.js`, `session.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `teamService.js`) are now on `db.execute({ sql, params })`. Left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` (vendored, replaced on upgrade) and `cache.query` calls untouched — `verify.js` confirms a clean pass.
